findings.title: Gateway names a GatewayClass that does not exist
findings.cause: Gateway public names GatewayClass nginx, which does not exist, so no controller takes the Gateway: it gets no address, and the routes attached to it are served by nothing; the cluster's GatewayClasses are kd-faults

evidence.command: kubectl get gateway public -n kd-gateway-class-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.gatewayClassName}'

findings.fix: Set gatewayClassName to a class the cluster has (kubectl get gatewayclasses); a Gateway's class cannot be changed, so delete the Gateway and create it again with the right one.
